more_info.overview: Triacetin is glyceryl triacetate, in which glycerol is esterified with three acetate groups. Its moisture-control role is to help prevent a food from drying out. The specified material is supplied as colourless liquid. EU permissions include chewing gum.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain chewing gum.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
more_info.daily_intake: For triacetin: No ADI specified (JECFA, 2002). This evaluation does not establish an ADI for every form in the named group.
